authority_gap_confirmed.result: Every one of the four values is excluded for the condition, so the set of representable states was empty. The authority was incomplete (no representation) and, read with the fail-safe default, left the implementation to choose; production chose NOT_AVAILABLE through a fallback normalizer, which is the contradiction the owner rejected.
authority_gap_confirmed.existing_vocabulary_searched: authority/strategy and the specs under development/implementation/tests/specs were searched for NOT_APPLICABLE, NOT_EVALUATED, DEVELOPMENT_NOT_OPERATIONAL, pre-activation and activation_state as freshness or readiness states: no governed freshness state represents the condition (NOT_EVALUATED, DEVELOPMENT_NOT_OPERATIONAL and activation_state are implementation labels, not authority). NOT_APPLICABLE exists only as a traceability applicability vocabulary.

authority_correction.why_this_name: The activation contracts say development state "only means that the obligation of consecutive daily freshness has not started counting" (EOD_SOURCE_OPERATIONAL_RESILIENCE_CONTRACT_LOCKED.md) and that operational freshness obligations begin only at the marker and are never backdated (Terminology_and_Scope.md). The condition is therefore that operational freshness is not in force, not that an assessment is pending: "not applicable" states that, "not assessed" would suggest an omitted evaluation and collides with the governance verdict NOT_ASSESSED. NOT_APPLICABLE follows the existing applicability vocabulary of the traceability standard. NOT_EVALUATED, DEVELOPMENT_NOT_OPERATIONAL and the other production labels were not reused because they are implementation labels, not authority, and the owner excluded production behavior as a source.
authority_correction.normative_definition: NOT_APPLICABLE: operational freshness is not yet in force for the requested trade date (that date precedes the effective OPERATIONAL_START_DATE or equivalent governed marker, or no marker is effective); no operational freshness assessment is made or claimed. It is not a freshness verdict: it never means FRESH, never means lateness, and never means that no consumer-safe result exists.

semantics.A_readable_independent_of_freshness: readiness_state and freshness_state are independent facts; neither is derived from or substitutes for the other; a pre-activation (including bounded historical or replay) publication is READABLE whenever every READABLE condition holds.
semantics.C_what_it_means: Freshness not applicable (the obligation is not in force). Not "not yet assessed", not "unavailable", not "unknown".
semantics.D_activation_transition: Operational freshness is in force for a requested trade date only when an explicit governed marker is effective on or before that date; it is decided from the requested date and the marker alone, never from the read time. When a marker becomes effective, dates on or after it are decided by the ordered rows; a publication already sealed for an earlier date keeps its sealed freshness state and is not re-evaluated, relabelled or rewritten.
semantics.E_FRESH: Unchanged definition plus applicability: READABLE requested publication, no activated degraded condition, freshness in force for the date, and all activated operational freshness gates pass.
semantics.F_STALE: Unchanged: a readable prior publication is deliberately returned (allowed fallback) and its older effective date is visible; applies in every phase and is never used merely because activation has not happened.
semantics.G_DEGRADED: Unchanged: an explicit activated, declared, non-silent degraded condition applies; none is declared by this correction.
semantics.H_NOT_AVAILABLE: Unchanged: no consumer-safe result is returned (no readable publication and no allowed fallback, or an integrity-ambiguous binding); a READABLE requested publication never carries it.
semantics.I_pre_activation_publication_in_manifest: A READABLE pre-activation publication may and must appear in the publication manifest and the downstream read product with freshness_state NOT_APPLICABLE and the operational activation context that explains it.
semantics.J_hashing: The decided freshness state is recorded in the publication manifest and in every semantic hash that binds a freshness state as that exact value; NOT_APPLICABLE is a state value like the others, never null, empty or NOT_AVAILABLE.

publication_manifest_consequence.also_binds_freshness: The V2 eligibility artifact payload also binds a freshness state per row (MD-S005-R0056); it carries the same decided state, so the eligibility batch hash and every hash that includes it change for such publications. V1-profile publications are historical and unchanged.
